targets: actual smooth IoU gain (empty trial restores baseline)
purity of removed pixels a/(a+b); 0 for ineffective/empty-fallback action

normalization: All regression labels bounded: purity/coverage/removal purity in [0,1], direct delta in [-1,1]. No GT features. Matched candidates only, all success/failure groups; same training images and rows for all heads.
action: Existing fixed smooth only, or baseline; newly empty trial restores baseline. Scores/classes/boxes/candidate count unchanged.
decode_predictions: Let p=predicted purity, c=predicted coverage, z=predicted removed purity, r=observed removed area/A. Clip p,c to [1e-6,1], z to [0,1]. u=clip(z*r,max(0,p+r-1),min(p,r)) is removed TP/A; v=r-u is removed FP/A. Predicted G/A=p/c; J0=p/(p/c+1-p); J1=(p-u)/(p/c+1-r-p+u); coverage loss=u*c/p. These identities recover exact GT-derived values when supplied exact labels; clipping enforces feasible nested counts.

selection.damage_budget: number of IoU75 damages of frozen RCMC on the same 500 train2017 selection images
selection.rule: For each learned variant choose among declared cutoffs under frozen RCMC damage budget: most target repairs, then fewest all-success damages, then most all-failure repairs, then greatest summed matched IoU gain, then higher cutoff. Cutoff 1.0 keeps baseline and guarantees feasibility. No selection on val AP or val diagnoses.
selection.final_evaluation: Freeze selected cutoffs and fitted estimators, evaluate all five variants once on original 4500 val IDs, retaining full GT/prediction lists.

support.pareto: target repairs >= comparator and all-success damages <= comparator, at least one strict
support.ap: COCO Mask AP >= both comparators; report point differences, no AP CI claim
support.uncertainty: 2000 paired image bootstrap of target repair rate, all-success damage rate and net counts; pointwise exploratory intervals. If point estimates pass but uncertainty does not resolve better dimension, evidence insufficient. All criteria relative to both controls.
support.failure: If point criteria fail, hypothesis not supported for this fixed feature/action/split setting; end goal with results, no expansion.

scope_limits: One seed; no YOLO training; no new features/data/action intensities.
val has prior exploratory use; no new blind-test claim.
Equal ceiling of 300 trees x 7 leaves in matched direct/decomposed calibrators, actual leaf counts/fit time/file size reported; multi-output allocation remains an inductive-bias difference.
Old RCMC has 100 trees and is reported independently, not misrepresented as capacity matched.
Regression components diagnose learnability but do not identify the unique origin of spillover.
